verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say findings are ranked by severity and that the review aims to surface issues that matter without low-signal feedback. Display presets (Minimal/Standard/Comprehensive) and the ability to dismiss findings give teams ways to cut noise. However, deduplication is never mentioned and the low-false-positive claim is vendor-only, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of comment deduplication, measured or independent evidence of low false-positive rates, and hands-on corroboration that noise stays low in practice.
